Corporate partners

More ways for a company to help.

Not every company has a sponsorship budget. These count just as much, and some are easier to approve.

  • Give in kind
    Host a night in your space, cover the pizza, or lend a training room for a workshop.
  • Match your employees' gifts
    CLE AI & DATA is a 501(c)(3), so gifts from your staff can qualify for your matching program. Tell your team we're on the list.
  • Run a workshop
    Send someone who has done the work to teach a hands-on session. Laptops open, real problems.
  • Hire from here
    Share your data and AI openings with our members, and meet candidates at the next big night.
